StepDescription: -- SCENARIO A: Access Plan, Alerts, Problems, Allergies --
Wait for home page to load
Wait for Patients tab to load
Generate random surname for new patient
Search for new patient using random surname
Click Registration link to open registration form
Click Find to resolve address from postal code
Click Next to proceed to demographics section
Wait for demographics section to load
Click Finish to complete patient registration
Capture and store NHS Number allocated to patient
Verify NHS Number is not empty
Click OK to dismiss confirmation popup
Wait for home page after registration
Click Find Record to search for registered patient
Wait for patient basic search form
Enter random surname to find registered patient
Click Find to search for patient
Click patient surname link to open EPR
Wait for EPR view to load
Verify EPR loaded - PASID field exists
Store PAS ID from EPR for reference
Click Referrals tab to create referral
Wait for Referrals tab to load
Click Finish Now to submit referral
-- SCENARIO A: Record Access Plan Entry --
Click Access Planning tab in EPR
Wait for Access Planning section to load
Click Create Access Plan Entry link
Wait for Access Plan source selection page
Click Next to proceed to Access Plan details
Wait for Access Plan details page
Click Next to proceed to Resource Monitoring
Click Finish Now to create Access Plan entry
Wait for Access Plan entry creation confirmation
Click Health Issues tab in EPR
Wait for Health Issues page to load
Wait for Alerts tab to load
Click Add to add alert details
Click Finish Now to save alert record
Wait for alert record save confirmation
Wait for Problems tab to load
Click Select Problem icon to open search
Click Search icon to find problem
Click OK to select problem from results
Wait for Allergies tab to load
Click Add to add allergen details
Click Finish Now to save allergy record
Wait for allergy record save confirmation
-- SCENARIO A: Click Overview and Validate CPP View --
Wait for Overview/Summary page to load
Wait for CPP View tab to load
Verify Alerts count is displayed in CPP view
Verify Alerts link is displayed in CPP view
Verify Problems count is displayed in CPP view
Verify Problems link is displayed in CPP view
Verify Allergies/ADRs count is displayed in CPP view
Verify Allergies/ADRs link is displayed in CPP view
Logout of Lorenzo application - Scenario A
